Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added per-keyword max unit prices. Replaced the default keyword set with Ceremonial at 20,000 gil, Archeo Kingdom at 15,000 gil, Rinascita at 15,000 gil, Diadoch at 15,000 gil, and Classical at 12,000 gil. AutoBuy now checks listings against the price cap for the current item's configured keyword.
